title: Schematic graph
description: In-memory representation of a transcribed schematic. Source of truth on disk is the .kicad_sch file; this schema describes the intermediate graph the pipeline operates on.

scan_path.description: relative path to the source PNG

junctions.description: Connection-dot points on this sheet, in source-image pixels. KiCad needs an explicit (junction (at x y)) at every spot where two wires cross AND connect — without one, KiCad treats the crossing as independent. Recognised by the tracer (LLM vision) at the same time as the wire paths. Each junction is rendering-only on our side because the graph already knows connectivity via endpoints; on the KiCad side it controls whether the rendered .kicad_sch shows the dot.

refdes.description: Manufacturer's reference designator preserved as written, e.g. U14C

verified.description: Human has visually confirmed this component (refdes, part, bbox approximately right). AI-added components default to absent/false; humans toggle via the explorer or graph_cli verify-component.

verified_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the verification was set (optional).

pin_positions.description: Per-pin coordinates [x,y] in source-image pixels. Keys are pin numbers as strings. Auto-seeded by the viewer using a default DIP layout; user-refined by dragging.

name.description: Mnemonic name, e.g. A0, ~CSC, GND. Tilde prefix denotes active-low.

pin.description: Pin number or name as defined in chips.json

edge_type.description: How the connection is expressed on paper. Mixing types in one net is an error.

sheet_zone_ref.description: For edge_type=sheet_zone: original notation as drawn, e.g. 4C6

path.description: Routed polyline for this net in source-image pixels. Right-angle segments only (every consecutive pair differs in exactly one of x/y). Provided by the tracer (LLM vision reading the source) so the KiCad export can emit (wire ...) segments matching the original artwork instead of straight pin-to-pin diagonals. When absent the exporter falls back to a one-corner Manhattan route between endpoints. Rendering only — connectivity is canonical via `endpoints`.

path_source.description: Provenance of the path. `human` overrides `ai` overrides `tracer`.

evidence.description: Provenance of an assertion in the graph.

probe_log_ref.description: Anchor in discrepancies.md if verified or contradicted by a board probe
